n: Concord Consortium Precipitating Change weather unit
t: A middle school weather unit where students forecast a virtual storm.
steps: Open the online teacher edition from the Concord Consortium.
Set up the teacher dashboard for your class if needed.
Open the virtual models in a browser.
Share the student science notebook as a Google Doc or PDF.
Plan the 7 lessons, which search results put at about 13 class periods of 45 minutes.
